title: elaeagnus pungens f. rotundifolia
intro: Elaeagnus pungens f. rotundifolia, commonly known as Silverberry or Wolfberry, is a shrub native to Asia and North America, known for its silver-gray foliage and small, white flowers. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Elaeagnus pungens f. rotundifolia include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to exhibit anti-cancer, anti-aging, and neuroprotective properties, highlighting its potential as a valuable medicinal resource.
